ActorTalk: Scepter, Laurel, Blade... what metrics did these houses use to sort our seniors back then?

The Laurel House valued academic knowledge, technical skills, and political acumen, and the Blade House put an emphasis on the implementation of tactics as well as combat performance. Meanwhile, Scepter looked for strategic coordination and control over the battlefield.
Right, and based on what you just said, which house do you think we'd each be assigned to?
